summary.text: Lindsey Tichenor is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 6 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as realtor.

paragraphs.text: Tichenor was born in Louisville, Kentucky.

Her career experience includes work as a realtor with Covenant Realty, LLC, as executive regional vice president of Arbonne International, and as an international missionary with Water Step/Edge Outreach.
She has served as a precinct and education chair of the Oldham County GOP and is a standing member of the Oldham County Republican Women's Club.
Tichenor took office in the Kentucky State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding C.B. Embry Jr.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her on the Senate Education (vice chair), Health and Welfare, Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection, and State and Local Government committees.
